items.rationale: Sections 4.2.2 and 7.1.9–7.1.10 cover like-for-like replacement of a fixed unit damaged beyond repair, with no kitchen-location exclusion. The €1,413 estimate assumes the surge was atmospheric and the fire group was selected, neither of which is confirmed in the claim description.

Under §7.1.11, necessary installation follows the covered replacement at €480 for one ordinary installation. Any separate wiring check or work on other equipment must be allocated before payment under §9.5.

Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.7 limit payment to a damaged pre-loss console or one that necessarily had to be removed and could not be refitted. The description confirms a console existed but not that it needed replacing; the conditional estimate is €61 for one equivalent console.
Under §7.1.11, ordinary freight for the covered AC replacement is payable at about €43 for one shipment. Any freight attributable to unrelated equipment must be apportioned out.
